## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refresh operation must preserve existing fingerprints before merge because it currently makes verification accept hand-edited tracked files.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register previously unlisted files, with tests for manifest updates and preservation behavior. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — When you pass an edited tracked file alongside a new file to `refresh_fingerprints`, it replaces the tracked file’s original digest, causing `verify` to return true. The unconditional assignment overwrites existing manifest entries. — Users who include hand-edited tracked files during refresh lose the integrity check that should detect those edits. — Fix: Reuse `register_new_files` and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries` to cover an edited tracked file.
